segments.name: _TEXT
segments.content: game code 0x439..0x9613 (after C0S 0x200..0x439), Borland CS.LIB runtime 0x9613..data_end
evidence: segment value 0x0000 is the relocated target of the two `seg _TEXT` immediates at load-module 0x60DC/0x60F5 (keyboard-ISR far pointer _TEXT:0x610B in F_6293)

segments.name: FAR_0B31
segments.class: FAR_DATA (hypothesis: class name from C0S segment order)

format.record: byte 0 = level index to load; then input bytes: low nibble = direction 0..7 (8 = none), bit 7 / bit 6 = buttons; 0x20 n = repeat previous input n frames; 0x30 = end of demo

evidence: F_519B 0x51E5: g_demo_data (DS:0x57A4) = MK_FP(0x0B31,0) via relocated immediate at lm 0x4FEF
F_09DE 0xB63..0xB9F: idx = rand() %% es:[0]; g_demo_pos = es:[4+4*idx]; g_current_level = es:[g_demo_pos++]; g_demo_mode = 1
F_4A27 0x4A69..0x4AF0: 0x20 -> g_demo_repeat = next byte; 0x30 -> end of demo; else dir = b&0xF, button bits from b>>7 and b>>6

segments.name: FAR_0C42
segments.class: FAR_DATA (hypothesis: class name from C0S segment order)
segments.content: RLE-compressed CGA tileset (the in-EXE counterpart of EGADAVE.DAV)

format.rle: b>=0x80: copy b-0x7F literal bytes; b<0x80: repeat next byte b+3 times

evidence: F_1321 0x1356..0x1382 (CGA case): far ptr MK_FP(0x0C42,0) (relocated immediate); unrle(dst=g_tileset, src=+4, len=u32 at +0) via 0x7E00 -> 0x7ED4

decoding with the 0x7ED4 algorithm yields a count + strictly increasing offset table whose first offset == 4 + 4*count, and 53 leading 64-byte tiles (16x16 at 2bpp depth), matching EGADAVE.DAV's 53 fixed tiles

padding.note: bytes after the RLE stream are never read by the decoder; 2 non-zero leftover byte(s) then zero alignment

segments.name: _INIT_/_EXIT_
segments.content: Borland startup/exit routine tables: _INIT_ = 2 x 6-byte records, _EXIT_ empty
evidence: C0S at file 0x2DD: mov ax,0x254C; mov ds,ax; mov si,0x0; mov di,0xC; call (startup walk) and again with si=di=0xC (exit walk); relocations at lm 0xDE/0x110
records point at runtime init code: priority 2 -> setupio-style stdio init at file 0x9C6F (tests __streams flags at DS:0x4A4A), priority 16 -> __setenvp__ at file 0xB49B (stores _environ DS:0x4C5E)
entry point (file 0x200) `mov dx,0x254D` is relocated (lm 0x0001); C0S stores it in DGROUP@ (cs:[0x235]) and loads DS from it
